surface: All 1,512 canonical icons from @phosphor-icons/core@2.1.1, including the upstream deprecated Icon-suffixed aliases, six weights, IconContext, IconBase, root exports, and per-icon imports.
divergences: Icon refs are normal Octane ref props rather than React forwardRef components.
Event callbacks receive native DOM events rather than React synthetic events.
The React package's SSR namespace is unnecessary because Octane icons use the same components on client and server.
ssr: Supported and tested against @phosphor-icons/react/ssr for every weight; hydration adopts and updates server-rendered SVG hosts.
notes: Generated modules embed only their own official @phosphor-icons/core SVG geometry, preserving per-icon tree shaking.
Generation checks pin core metadata, six canonical assets per icon, and the React oracle version.
